authorityBoundary: Only explicit API/public-wire authority may close these items; entity fields, persistence mappings, generated types, examples, or implementation behavior are non-authoritative for this gate.
established: Canonical operations: authCredentialList, authCredentialAdd, authCredentialReplace, authCredentialRemove.
Mutations require authenticated self scope and Idempotency-Key.
Secret-derived and internal credential fields are non-public.

blockers.why: No explicit public field names/requiredness or kind-change semantics in current API contract.
No authoritative public response field set; current entity authority forbids inference.

blockers.item: List pagination envelope, cursor and ordering

blockers.why: Generic ResourceId exists, but credential namespace is not explicitly bound to it.

blockers.why: Current AUTH-003 contract does not define exact success statuses; remove body-vs-204 is also open.

blockers.why: Shared error categories exist, but AUTH-003-specific HTTP/code mapping is not explicit.
Unknown-property rejection and examples depend on the approved schema; examples cannot become schema authority.

prohibitedActions: Do not add guessed request or response fields.
Do not infer credentialId format from Payload IDs or another entity namespace.
Do not infer list cursor envelope from unrelated API contracts.
Do not infer success/error HTTP mappings from generic categories alone.
Do not write AUTH-003 routes into OpenAPI yet.
Do not promote DTO registry or Mapping-0.
